setting.name: Known Space
setting.description: The launch-era inhabited and commercially connected region of Far Haul. Route links represent gameplay/trade connectivity, not literal map geometry.
design_rules: Every populated location must answer why people settled there, why they remain, and what they need from somewhere else.
Political borders and trade regions do not map cleanly to species.
First contact occurred generations before game start; multispecies commerce is ordinary.
Exploration extends the freight network rather than replacing it.
